index.intro: This folder contains {count} editable ComfyUI workflows, grouped by model. Each graph has connected nodes and setup instructions.
index.language: Only English examples are included. Notes and custom node titles are saved in the graph; changing the interface language does not translate them.
index.limits: Live workflows stop at the chosen duration. Fast H3 can create a chosen number of consecutive clips. Media inputs start empty; use your own files or the samples below.
index.openSteps:
1. Open a JSON file listed below in ComfyUI. Built packages also include these examples in **Templates → reactor-inc**.
2. Read **Start Here** and upload the required image or video.
3. Set your key in **Extensions → Reactor → Reactor settings**, then select **Run**.
index.portraitUse: Make a portrait speak with LTX.
index.previews: These images show frames from Reactor output. Your results can differ. Project rights in the previews use the same MIT license.
index.reuse: The sample images are generated illustrations. The portrait depicts a fictional adult. Project rights in the samples are licensed under [MIT]({license}). They are inputs, not examples of Reactor output.
index.samples: Download a sample, then select it in the matching image or video input node.
index.save: **Preview and Save Video** writes to `video/reactor/` under the ComfyUI output folder. Examples with sound also save a separate audio file.
index.stop: Use ComfyUI's cancel control to stop a queued run. Closing a tab does not cancel it. In a live panel, **End session** stops early and discards the unfinished video.
index.title: Reactor Workflows
index.update: Updates do not replace graphs already open in ComfyUI. Save your changes, then open the new example in another tab. Copy any prompts or settings you want to keep.
index.videoDetails: The sample video adds a slow zoom to the forest image: 120 frames at 24 fps, 640 × 360 pixels, standard dynamic range, and no sound. It uses the same license as the images.
index.videoUse: Edit a five-second clip with SANA or X2.

limits.continuation: The {clips} clips continue from each previous final frame. Put one prompt per line in **Later prompts**, starting with clip 2. Leave it empty to repeat the opening prompt.
limits.fast: Fast H3 rounds each clip to a supported length.
limits.helios: Each Helios chunk contains 33 frames. Connect prompts in order and use increasing **Start chunk** values. The opening prompt starts at chunk 0. Later prompts do not extend the recording.
limits.longlive: Each LongLive chunk is about 1.2 seconds at 24 fps. The soft transition starts near 1.2 seconds; the hard cut near 2.4 seconds. Increase **Video length (seconds)** if you schedule later shots.
limits.ltx: Use a clear portrait with the whole head visible.
limits.sourceVideo: Use standard dynamic range (SDR) video. The edited output has no sound.
limits.totalDuration: This example requests {seconds:g} seconds in total. In Reactor settings, **Maximum video duration (seconds)** must allow the combined length. The model may round each clip up.

live.camera: Select **Enable camera**, allow access, then **Start session**. Reactor receives camera video without microphone audio.
live.drag: Drag on the output to steer the subject. Escape releases the pointer. **Help** also explains keyboard controls.
live.finish: Let recording finish to save the video. **End session** stops early and discards it.
live.move: In the live panel, click the picture. W A S D moves; arrow keys turn. Escape stops movement. **Apply prompt** changes later frames.
live.prompt: Edit **Scene prompt**, then select **Apply prompt** to change later frames.
live.sound: **Apply sound prompt** changes later sound. The live preview is silent.
live.start: In the live panel, select **Start session** within 60 seconds.
live.editPrompt: Change **Edit prompt**, then select **Apply prompt** to change later frames.

setup.endingImage: Upload the ending image in **Choose the Final Frame**.
setup.image: Upload an image in **Upload Your Starting Image**.
setup.key: Set your key in **ComfyUI menu → Extensions → Reactor → Reactor settings**.
setup.live: Select **Run** to open the live panel.
setup.portrait: Upload a portrait in **Upload Your Starting Image**.
setup.prompt: Edit **Scene prompt** to describe the scene or change you want.
setup.record: Select **Run** to create and save the video.
setup.reference: Upload the subject to insert in **Upload Your Reference Subject**.
setup.sequence: Edit the opening prompt, **1. Let Sunlight Through**, and **2. Enter a Clearing**.
setup.shots: Edit the opening prompt, **1. Soft Transition**, and **2. Hard Cut**.
setup.speech: Edit **Spoken words**. Keep the speech short enough for five seconds.
setup.video: Upload a video in **Upload Your Source Video** (at least 33 frames).
setup.viskoImage: Edit **Scene prompt** to name what is in your image and describe its motion. The example prompt describes a forest path.
setup.editPrompt: Describe the change you want in **Edit prompt**.
